sections.text_helper: Section 49.8.16 "CRYP key register 3R (CRYP_K3RR)" in chapter 49 (Cryptographic processor (CRYP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2403.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x3C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:0 K[31:0]: Key bit x (x= 31 to 0)
This write-only bitfield contains the bits [31:0] of the AES encryption or decryption key,
depending on the operating mode.
Refer to the CRYP_K0LR register for information relative to writing CRYP_KxR/LR registers.
